postal_system.full_code_rule: Preserve all four digits, including a leading zero. A postcode identifies an NZ Post delivery-network unit, not necessarily a residential polygon.
postal_system.urban_rule: An urban delivery postcode may use a licensed PNF polygon, but address and building detail require separate evidence.
postal_system.rural_delivery_rule: An RD postcode may be a single-part or multi-part delivery area. RD number and mailtown are routing data and do not prove physical locality or building.
postal_system.box_bag_rule: PO Box and Private Bag postcodes identify box lobbies or postal routing and are non-areal unless licensed PNF geometry explicitly says otherwise.
postal_system.building_rule: LINZ building outlines are roof footprints. Proximity or containment alone does not create an exact address-to-building link.
postal_system.territory_rule: Cook Islands, Niue, Tokelau, and other separately coded territories remain independent ISO packs even when mail is handled through the NZ Post network.

exception_classes.rule: Use licensed PNF geometry for postcode area and separate PAF or open LINZ evidence for address detail.
Preserve RD number, route, mailtown, multipart geometry, and restricted-data status without treating the RD number as a house number.
Return the box or bag routing context and optional lobby point; do not infer a street premise or surrounding polygon.
Keep the postcode as a four-character string through ingestion, storage, API serialization, and export.
A LINZ roof outline near an address remains candidate geometry until a source-backed relationship resolves ambiguity.
Route CK, NU, TK, and other independent ISO codes to their own country packs.
Version PNF, PAF, addresses, buildings, roads, and boundaries with separate valid and known times.

quality_gates.pass: Every source has a pinned release, digest, terms reference, attribution, geographic scope, and transformation method.
NZ Post assignment and PNF geometry, restricted PAF/API fields, LINZ address points, LINZ roof outlines, Stats NZ boundaries, and AGID indexes remain separate.
A displayed building has one coherent source-backed address path; nearest or containing roof outlines remain derived candidates.
Single and multipart geometry is valid, versioned, bounded, and keeps box-lobby and non-area records distinct.
No unlicensed PNF, PAF, API Restricted Data, recipient, occupant, phone, instruction, credential, or customer record is published.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy production gates.

stages.definition: Source roles and legal blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
Pinned rights-cleared snapshots reproduce experimental packs with full lineage.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, freshness, and correction gates pass.
Two network refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
